page.overview:
What is The Eleventh Metal?

The Eleventh Metal is a fantasy short story, written by Brandon Sanderson, and released in 2012, as part thumbof the Mistborn series, which tells the backstory of Kelsier, and can now be found in Arcanum Unbounded:  The Cosmere Collection.
